headline: CORE LITHIUM CXO SURGES 8% — FINNISS POURS FIRST SPODUMENE CONCENTRATE ON SEPT QUARTER TARGET; FIRST SHIPMENT DEC 2026
snippet: Core Lithium (ASX: CXO) achieved first spodumene concentrate from the recommissioned processing plant at its Finniss Lithium Operation in the Northern Territory on September 8, 2026, meeting its September quarter target exactly six months after announcing the final investment decision — sending CXO shares up 8% in Sydney trading. The logistics chain is already operational with first shipment targeted for the December 2026 quarter; nameplate capacity of 1.2 million tonnes per year is targeted by mid-2028, placing Finniss in production in the same window China's supply constraints from the CATL Jianxiawo EIA shutdown are expected to deepen.

headline: FOUR RIGS TURNING AT PECOY — COPPER JUNIOR RAMPS 35,000M PROGRAM ONE YEAR AFTER TSX-V DEBUT; BEST INTERCEPT: 804M AT 0.34% CU FROM 24M
snippet: Pecoy Copper (TSX-V: PCU) marked its one-year anniversary of TSX Venture listing on September 8, 2026 by ramping to four active drill rigs at its namesake copper-gold-molybdenum-silver porphyry project in southern Peru, with a fifth rig planned as the fully funded 35,000-metre 2026 program scales up. Previously released assays include 804 metres at 0.34% Cu, 0.08 g/t Au from just 24 metres depth and 42.3 metres at 1.01% Cu near surface — near-surface porphyry copper at record LME prices above $14,600 per tonne underscores the re-rating potential if the 2026 program expands known mineralization across the multi-target property.

headline: GOLD X2 HITS 40.4M AT 2.05 g/t AU AT SPAN PROSPECT — NORTHEAST EXTENSION OF 6.67Moz MOSS DEPOSIT CONFIRMED IN NORTHWEST ONTARIO
snippet: Gold X2 Mining (TSX-V: AUXX, NYSE American: AUX) reported that initial Phase 1 drilling at the Span Prospect — approximately 2 km northeast of the 6.67-million-ounce Moss and East Coldstream gold deposits in Northwest Ontario — returned 40.4 metres at 2.05 g/t Au from 343.6 metres in 11 holes totalling 4,581 metres. A second rig is now mobilizing to extend the mineralization toward surface and to the northeast, with the program targeting the structural corridor interpreted to connect the Span Prospect to the existing deposit — a deposit with 2.46 million ounces indicated at 1.04 g/t Au and 4.21 million ounces inferred at 0.97 g/t Au.

headline: PANORO DRILLS 808M AT 0.22% CUEQ TO 1,100M DEPTH — SOUTH PIT HIGH-GRADE ZONE 'SET TO GROW SIGNIFICANTLY' AT COTABAMBAS PERU
snippet: Panoro Minerals (TSX-V: PML) released assay results confirming continuous hypogene mineralization from surface to approximately 1,100 metres depth at the South Pit of its Cotabambas copper-gold project in Peru — drillhole CB-230 hit 808.15 metres at 0.22% Cu from 296 metres, including 156.5 metres at 0.38% Cu and a 48.1-metre zone at 0.57% Cu, while CB-229 returned 303.3 metres at 0.14% Cu. The company stated the South Pit's high-grade contribution to the total Cotabambas resource 'is set to grow significantly,' with mineralization open in multiple directions at a project situated adjacent to the producing Constancia and Las Bambas mines in a proven copper-producing district.

headline: TWIN GOLD ANOMALIES OPEN AT GOLDEN ROSE — 900M × 450M TARGET EMERGES ADJACENT TO EQUINOX'S VALENTINE MINE IN CENTRAL NEWFOUNDLAND
snippet: TRU Precious Metals (TSX-V: TRU) identified two new gold-in-soil anomalies at its Golden Rose Project in central Newfoundland on September 8, 2026 — Wood Lake East measuring 900 by 450 metres and Wood Lake Southwest at 450 by 450 metres — along the Cape Ray-Valentine Lake Shear Zones immediately adjacent to Equinox Gold's producing Valentine Mine. The company staked 394 additional claims along Golden Rose's southern boundary to secure the full anomaly footprint, with surface trenching now underway to establish whether the soil signatures connect to bedrock mineralisation at drill-ready grade and width.

headline: QUIMBAYA GOLD CONFIRMS COPPER-MOLYBDENUM PORPHYRY IN ALL 6 HOLES — 563M POTASSIC ZONE DRILLED AT TAHAMI CENTER COLOMBIA; ASSAYS SEPT-OCT
snippet: Quimbaya Gold (CSE: QIM) completed Phase 1 drilling at Tahami Center in Segovia, Antioquia, Colombia, reporting that all six holes across 2,927.9 metres intersected the copper-molybdenum porphyry system predicted by surface mapping and 3D magnetic inversion — with TCDH-006 hitting 563 metres of potassic alteration including a 150-metre intramineral porphyry zone. Assays from all six holes are pending in late September to October 2026; the Tahami Center sits immediately adjacent to a prolific high-grade gold mining camp, and the geological model now confirms a classic Cu-Mo porphyry underlies the full Tahami Center anomaly — a district context that expands the project's valuation ceiling once copper grades are confirmed.

headline: GALLOPER GOLD STARTS 7,000M GLOVER ISLAND DRILL PROGRAM — 30 HOLES TARGET NEWFOUNDLAND GOLD SYSTEM; KETTLE POND SOUTH FIRST UP
snippet: Galloper Gold (CSE: BOOM) commenced diamond drilling at its 11,721-hectare Glover Island gold project in central Newfoundland on September 8, 2026, opening a 30-hole, 7,000-metre NQ program following an integrated review of historical drilling, geochemistry, and geophysics across the license. The first target is the Kettle Pond South Zone, where previous operators intercepted 2.53 g/t gold over 21.3 metres — a poorly understood historic result the 2026 program is designed to retest, extend, and connect to the project's main resource on trend.

headline: ESKAY MINING COMPLETES 3,638M IN GOLDEN TRIANGLE — 9 HOLES ACROSS PORPHYRY AND STACKED VEIN TARGETS; RESULTS EXPECTED OCTOBER TO DECEMBER
snippet: Eskay Mining (TSX-V: ESK) updated shareholders on September 8, 2026, confirming 3,638 metres of NQ diamond drilling completed in nine holes at its consolidated Eskay Project in BC's Golden Triangle, testing copper-gold porphyry targets (Vermillion, TM, Big Red) and the Sultan stacked gold vein target — all within two kilometres of the Kyba Line unconformity that controls many of the district's major deposits. ALS assay results from all 2026 holes are expected between October and December, with the project straddling the historic Eskay Creek mine footprint, which produced more than 3.3 million ounces of gold equivalent at an average head grade reported at approximately 45 g/t AuEq.

headline: SILVER HOLDS $66 AS IRAN DRIVES OIL TOWARD $100 — OUTPERFORMS GOLD'S 0.6% DIP WITH INDUSTRIAL DEMAND ABSORBING MACRO HEADWIND
snippet: Silver held above $66 per troy ounce on Tuesday September 8, 2026 — up 1.17% on the day — as Iran conflict escalations drove oil toward $100 per barrel, even while gold fell 0.6% to $4,443 on the same macro signal. Silver's divergent strength reflects industrial demand from solar manufacturing and strategic government stockpiling that operates independently of the speculative precious metals bid — an important distinction for junior silver miner investors who need to track whether silver's floor is macro-driven or structurally supported, as China's January 2026 reclassification of silver as a strategic material indicates the latter.

headline: SILVER'S UNSUNG STRENGTH: WHY $66 OUTPERFORMS THE SELLOFF NARRATIVE AND WHAT THE 65-TO-1 GOLD-SILVER RATIO SIGNALS NEXT
snippet: GoldSeek's analysis argues that silver trading at its best levels in over a decade — despite a 46% correction from January 2026's $121.79 COMEX peak — reflects structural demand strength rather than cyclical failure, driven by solar manufacturing growth, a sixth consecutive annual supply deficit, and China's January reclassification of silver as a strategic material. The gold-to-silver ratio holding above 65-to-1, versus a historical 55-60x average, is identified as the key signal: when the ratio compresses toward historical norms — as it did briefly at the January peak — silver's leverage to a renewed gold advance is the single highest-returning precious metals trade in the current cycle, and the structural supply deficit ensures that compression is a matter of 'when' rather than 'if.'
